description: Update the Prefect system to enable flow heartbeat monitoring by default instead of having it disabled. Change the default heartbeat frequency from None (disabled) to 180 seconds, allowing the system to automatically detect zombie or crashed flow runs without requiring user configuration. Users should still be able to disable heartbeats by explicitly setting the configuration to None.
functional_requirements: Update the default value for the heartbeat_frequency setting from None to 180 seconds in the flows configuration module
Ensure the settings schema is regenerated to reflect the new default value in the JSON schema
Maintain backward compatibility by allowing users to disable heartbeats by explicitly setting PREFECT_FLOWS_HEARTBEAT_FREQUENCY to None
